name: The Shadow over Willowtown
source:
Our story starts in 1985 (Doc!). The main protagonist is a young man that's starting his life as a student along with his two best friends, at the prestigious Willowtown University situated on the island.

It's also a sort of homecoming for our hero, who left the island as a child with his mother, but doesn't really remember anything from that part of his younger life.

Troubled with his nightmares and finding himself surrounded by sinister forces, what will happen to him and his friends all depends on your choices.

[From [url=https://vncraft.itch.io/the-shadow-over-willowtown]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我们的故事始于1985年（博士！）。主角是一个年轻人，他和他的两个最好的朋友一起在岛上著名的威洛敦大学开始了学生生活。

对于我们的英雄来说，这也是一种回家，他小时候和母亲一起离开了这个岛，但他并不真正记得他年轻时的任何事情。

他饱受噩梦困扰，并发现自己被邪恶势力包围，他和他的朋友们会发生什么，一切都取决于你的选择。

[来自[url=https://vncraft.itch.io/the-shadow-over-willowtown]Itch.io[/url]]
